# TAOM co-op interop list
# ------------------------
# Read at startup by TAOM.Dependencies (CoopPresence). Entries here are ADDED to TAOM's
# compiled defaults — nothing in this file can remove a built-in entry, so a bad edit can
# never unprotect the BUTR/MCM stack. Delete the file to fall back to defaults only.
#
# Format: '#' comments, blank lines ignored, one entry per line under a section header.
# Entries before any header are treated as module ids.

[modules]
# Launcher module ids that mean "a co-op mod is running". When any of these is active,
# TAOM stops PatchShield from unpatching third-party Harmony patches and makes SaveShield
# rethrow save/load failures instead of swallowing them.
BannerlordTogether
BattleLinkMPClient
# BannerlordCoop (Workshop 3770450698) — a DIFFERENT mod from BannerlordTogether. Its launcher id
# is the bare string "Coop". Internals: docs/research/bannerlordcoop-internals.md
Coop

[harmony-owner-prefixes]
# Harmony owner ids (prefix match, case-insensitive) to add to PatchShield's protected-owner
# allowlist, so PatchShield never strips their patches.
#
# Empty by default, and normally it should stay that way: the unpatch path is already disabled
# outright whenever any module above is active, so an explicit allowlist entry is belt-and-braces.
# Add one only if you have a reason to.
#
# BannerlordTogether's package ships an explicit no-decompile / no-AI-analysis policy from its
# copyright holders. TAOM honours it: BT's Harmony id is never read out of its code, only from
# Harmony's own public runtime registry, printed by the [HarmonyCensus] lines in the TAOM log.
# That restriction is specific to BT's stated terms and is not a claim about every mod.
